name: @axessplayer/recommender
description: Recommender (what series to surface in the feed): two-tower retrieval + a multi-task ranker with a duration-debiased watch-time head + a feature store + exploration. Its training signal is engagement, kept SEPARABLE from the re-cutter's cut-selection propensity (CORRECTIONS C5) so a future experiment can isolate the cut. No em dashes.
